training_strategy: Two-Stage Transfer Learning (Stage 1 Head Training + Stage 2 Upper Backbone Fine-Tuning)

primary_sources: ICAR - Indian Institute of Horticultural Research (IIHR), Bengaluru
ICAR - Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI), Shimla
ICAR - Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR), Varanasi
Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU) Agritech Portal

generative_ai_guidance.grounding_constraint: Strictly evidence-grounded on RAG context; does not claim direct image diagnosis

limitations: Controlled-environment dataset bias: PlantVillage images are captured on uniform or laboratory-like backgrounds, which introduces domain shift when applied to cluttered farm environments with soil and weed noise.
Near-duplicate images in source dataset: While exact byte-identical duplicates were quarantined, near-identical photos from the same shoot may exist across splits.
Softmax confidence is not real-world calibrated probability; low-confidence warnings (<60%) must be heeded.
Weather API dependency: Real-time risk scoring relies on network connectivity and local meteorological station accuracy.
RAG and Gemini advice is advisory: It supports but does NOT replace licensed agricultural extension officers or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) agronomists.
